title: C¹ maps on open sets send Hᵏ-null sets to Hᵏ-null sets
statement: Let n, N, k ∈ ℕ, D ⊆ ℝⁿ open, ψ : ℝⁿ → ℝᴺ of class C¹ on D, and Z ⊆ D with Hᵏ(Z) = 0. Then Hᵏ(ψ(Z)) = 0 in ℝᴺ. No measurability or finiteness assumption on Z, and no relation between k and n, is needed. Notation: ℝ^d = Rn d = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d); Hᵏ = μHE[k], the k-dimensional Euclidean Hausdorff measure, which on arbitrary sets is the Hausdorff outer measure.
lean_statement: ∀ (n N k : ℕ) (D Z : Set (Rn n)) (ψ : Rn n → Rn N), IsOpen D → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 ψ D → Z ⊆ D → μHE[k] Z = 0 → μHE[k] (ψ '' Z) = 0
